tool.name: MGnify: Remove ambiguous reads
tool.description: Remove reads with ambiguous bases (Ns) or shorter than 100bp prior to DADA2
tool.command: ## The toolkit script opens inputs with fileinput.hook_compressed, i.e. gzip only ## when the file NAME ends in .gz. Upstream inputs may arrive as gzipped or plain ## fastq regardless of their declared Galaxy datatype (e.g. seqkit_grep writes ## plain fastq on stdout even for .gz input), so prepare the inputs by content: ## decompress when the payload is gzip, otherwise pass through under a plain name. #if $input_type.type == "paired_collection" ln -sf '$input_type.input.forward' fwd_in.dat && ln -sf '$input_type.input.reverse' rev_in.dat && if gunzip -t fwd_in.dat 2>/dev/null; then gunzip -c fwd_in.dat > fwd_plain.fastq; else ln -sf fwd_in.dat fwd_plain.fastq; fi && if gunzip -t rev_in.dat 2>/dev/null; then gunzip -c rev_in.dat > rev_plain.fastq; else ln -sf rev_in.dat rev_plain.fastq; fi && remove_ambiguous_reads -f fwd_plain.fastq -r rev_plain.fastq -s sample #else if $input_type.type == "paired_lists" ln -sf '$input_type.input_f' fwd_in.dat && ln -sf '$input_type.input_r' rev_in.dat && if gunzip -t fwd_in.dat 2>/dev/null; then gunzip -c fwd_in.dat > fwd_plain.fastq; else ln -sf fwd_in.dat fwd_plain.fastq; fi && if gunzip -t rev_in.dat 2>/dev/null; then gunzip -c rev_in.dat > rev_plain.fastq; else ln -sf rev_in.dat rev_plain.fastq; fi && remove_ambiguous_reads -f fwd_plain.fastq -r rev_plain.fastq -s sample #else ln -sf '$input_type.input' input_in.dat && if gunzip -t input_in.dat 2>/dev/null; then gunzip -c input_in.dat > input_plain.fastq; else ln -sf input_in.dat input_plain.fastq; fi && remove_ambiguous_reads -f input_plain.fastq -s sample #end if

param.name: input_f
param.label: Forward reads (list)
param.help: Forward mates as a list collection

param.name: input_r
param.label: Reverse reads (list)
param.help: Reverse mates as a list collection

tool.help:
**Remove ambiguous reads** ----------------------------
Removes reads that would break or bias **DADA2** inference, prior to running DADA2 (as done by the MGnify amplicon analysis pipeline).
A read pair is removed when either mate:
- contains **ambiguous bases (N)**, or - is shorter than **100 bases**
Inputs ------ - Paired-end fastq.gz collection, or a single-end fastq.gz dataset
Outputs ------- - Filtered reads in bgzf-compressed fastq format (``*_noambig*.fastq.gz``)
Notes ----- - Reads shorter than 100bp are always dropped; make sure upstream quality trimming (e.g. fastp with ``-l 100``) leaves enough reads. - Output order matches the input read order.
